episodes.title: Octubre Benigno
episodes.summary: Following Basque separatist group ETA's historic ceasefire, Bittori returns to her hometown demanding answers about her late husband Txato's unresolved murder.

episodes.title: Encuentros
episodes.summary: While Bittori breaks the estrangement between families by asking Joxian for an impossible favor, their children reunite and bond over Txato's kindness.

episodes.title: Últimas Meriendas
episodes.summary: With Joxe Mari on the run and threats against Txato escalating, life becomes increasingly difficult for both Bittori's and Miren's families.

episodes.title: Txato, Entzun, Pim, Pam, Pum
episodes.summary: ETA issues a dangerous set of orders for Joxe Mari and increases its pressure on Txato.

episodes.title: El País de los Callados
episodes.summary: Arantxa's budding friendship with Bittori drives her to go behind her mother's back and reach out to Joxe Mari with an urgent request.
